defects: f is typed as ℕ → ℝ instead of ℝ → ℝ, so the theorem only covers sequences realized as piecewise-constant (floor-extended) step functions rather than general antitone integrable real functions as in the gold — a fundamentally narrower and different statement

Uses `⊤` as the upper endpoint of a real interval integral/IntervalIntegrable (`(N-1:ℝ)..⊤`), but ℝ has no `Top`/`OrderTop` instance in Mathlib, so this does not type-check / references a nonexistent construction

The conclusion's integral ∫ f(⌊x⌋) over (N-1)..⊤ equals f(N-1) + tail-sum rather than the integral of a genuine antitone function as in the gold's ∫_{Ioi(N-1)} f, changing the mathematical content of the inequality (would make it essentially trivial given nonneg f(N-1))
hnonneg is required for all n : ℕ rather than only for t in (N-1, ∞) as in the gold, unnecessarily strengthening/altering the hypothesis
hantitone requires global Antitone f on all of ℕ rather than AntitoneOn f restricted to [N-1, ∞) as in the gold, unnecessarily strengthening the hypothesis
Uses deprecated `∑ n in Finset.range N` notation instead of `∑ n ∈ Finset.range N`
